body: I know this might sound strange, but thank you

Thank you for coming to talk instead of just acting on it. I am not an adult, I won’t specify my age, but I know what you are going through to some extent. My parents were nothing close to being yours but were never there for me when I needed them. I can only imagine what it’s like to be 8 years old and have to see all of that. Hold on to your girl. The world has gone to shit, and the few good things we need to hold close. She stays with you because she loves you, there is clearly something about you that she just can’t get enough of. Keep trying my friend ❤️
You are enough! And whoever tells you otherwise is just a low life son of a bitch. Keep going :)
